title: SSH Key Input
summary: Catches a private SSH key pasted where a public key belongs, plus weak, truncated or malformed public keys, before they're saved.
description: Public-key field that flags a pasted private key loudly (rotate it; extract the public half in one tap), catches DSA and short RSA keys, wrapped or cut-off keys, wrong type prefixes, SSH2 export format and duplicates, and shows the SHA256 fingerprint as ssh-keygen does.
catches: A private key pasted instead of a public one, with rotate advice and the public half extracted when possible
DSA keys and RSA keys under minRsaBits (default 2048; 3072 recommended)
Keys wrapped across lines or cut off
A key already on the account
limits: Checks key format and size, not who owns the key
A pasted private key has already been exposed to this page; advise rotation regardless
Certificate and hardware-key (sk-) variants may be reported generically
a11y: Visible <label>; aria-invalid on blocking issues; hint and report via aria-describedby
Private-key warning uses role=alert; summary is role=status
After a fix, focus moves to the next fix or back to the field
server: Re-validate the key server-side, reject private keys and weak types, and never log submitted key material.
stops: Private SSH key pasted where a public key belongs
mistakes: pasted private key instead of public
